

// package main




fn identity( value: i32) -> (i32) {
    
        

return value;



    
}
fn add( left: i32, right: i32) -> (i32) {
    
        

return left + right;



    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let first = identity(7)
;


let total = add(first, 5)
;



assert_eq!(total, 12);



    
}
